note: THE GROUND DECLARED NOTHING, AND NOW IT DECLARES ONE PICTURE OF UNDER TWO KILOBYTES. This fragment carried four textures: terrain-albedo and terrain-light, the painted meadow and its Cycles bake, and terrain-detail and terrain-path, the two maps of the paving that travelled here because the ground's own material ate them. All four went at step 8 of the rifondazione, and what they had been costing was 4 356 514 bytes of the first frame -- 70.9% of it, downloaded by every visitor and read by nobody. The meadow is ten centimetre cubes out to the tier's radius and a snapped sheet from there to a hundred metres, and both take their colour from arithmetic in src/world/voxel/material.js; the corridor is columns of that same disc wearing V3's own three maps. WHAT COMES BACK IN IS THE ONE THING ARITHMETIC COULD NOT DO. Research C measured, with one instrument on both pictures, that every material of the reference carries a light and dark INSIDE one face of a cube which this render has none of at all -- bare earth 2.40% of luminance against our 0.51%, the near meadow 1.16 against 0.43, the corridor 3.20 against 1.18 -- and that our own faces are flat by construction, because the fragment of the soil did not declare a single sampler. A grain inside a face is not a field of a position and cannot be hashed out of a cell: it is a picture of what a face is made of, and a picture has to be delivered. This is that picture, for the whole world, at four hundredths of one per cent of what the four that went were costing.

assets.note: The grain inside a face: one sixteen by sixteen grey square to a family and orientation -- grass top, grass flank, bare earth, the inside of a slab -- cut out of the day target by tools/materia/foglio.mjs at the pixels assets-src/materia/fogli.json names, and closed on a mean of exactly a half so the colour of the DISTANT world stays the pigment's and nothing else. IT TRAVELS AS A STRIP AND ARRIVES AS AN ARRAY. Sixteen wide, sixteen tall a layer, one under the next, so a layer is a contiguous run of 256 bytes and src/world/voxel/sheet.js cuts it into a sampler2DArray with an offset rather than a shuffle. `ktx create` takes --layers and would ship a layered file directly; three's loader would not read it back, because its uncompressed path returns a flat picture and drops the layer count, and the only path that rebuilds layers is the Basis transcoder -- which means a block codec, eight bits a texel spent by a search that works by making blocks resemble one another, on a square of two hundred and fifty six texels whose whole contract is the value of its own mean. NO MIPMAP IN THE FILE, for the same reason and it is the sharper one: a mip level of a STRIP averages across the boundary between two layers, which is exactly the defect an array exists to prevent. The chain is generated on the page, per slice, which is what generateMipmap on a 2D array does by definition. AND NO BLOCK CODEC AND NO TRANSFER: R8 raw with zstd, like the cloud's coverage beside it, because a grain is a fraction and not a picture and a texture with a transfer comes back from the sampler decoded. Critical and not deferred: it multiplies the albedo of the three families that cover a third of the frame, so a frame drawn before it lands is a different frame, and 1 247 bytes is not a thing to stream. THAT FIGURE IS THE FIRST OF ITS KIND IN THIS CAMPAIGN: research C left the weight of a delivered atlas open (6.7, 'il peso di un atlante consegnato non e' mai stato misurato'), and quoted the literature at 15 to 40 kB for twenty layers. Four layers cost 1 247 B, so twenty would cost about six.

THE ONE THING IN THIS WORLD THAT SAYS WHERE THE MEADOW IS DARK. A single channel of the ground plane, half a metre to a texel, eighty metres on a side over the whole plateau, whose value is the factor the field multiplies a fragment's LIGHT by: one where the meadow stands open and 0.28 at the floor. WHY IT COULD NOT BE ARITHMETIC, which is how every other field of this ground is answered. Research R1 measured the reference varying by ZONES of three to eight metres with a factor of 0.31 at the low decile against our 0.56, and its semivariance still RISING between two metres and four (0.059 to 0.073) where ours has stopped by two (0.027 to 0.025). Nothing in a cell can produce a structure eight metres across: it is where the light of one afternoon happened to fall, and a fact of that kind is written down or it is invented. IT IS TWO THINGS MULTIPLIED. The LAW is arithmetic over the seats the world already publishes -- an isotropic disc of contact shade at the foot of every block (0.32 over 5.4 m), every tree and every pile of stones (0.47 over 2.6 m), fitted on the reference's own profile by distance from those footprints -- so it follows them wherever they move and it is right in the whole disc, including behind the walker where no reference has ever looked. The RESIDUAL is what the law does not explain, measured with the instrument of R1 1.6 and written in assets-src/zone/residuo.json at one knot every two metres: the dark left foreground, the band before blocks 01 and 02, the pale middle distance to the right. AND THE FOOT IS ISOTROPIC AND IS NOT A CAST SHADOW: the seal's sun stands at azimuth 280 and 47 degrees up, so the shadow of block 01 would lie five metres to the east and there would be none at all to the west, and the reference is equally dark on all three sides (R1 1.7: west 35, front 39, east 30). B-6 says the same of the whole frame and E-SINTESI-DIVARIO D5/D6 settled it. R8 RAW WITH ZSTD AND NO BLOCK CODEC AND NO TRANSFER, for the reason the cloud's coverage beside it carries: a factor is a fraction and not a picture, a texture with a transfer comes back from the sampler decoded, and eight bits a texel spent by a search that works by making blocks resemble one another is the wrong price for a field whose whole content is a slow gradient. NOT CRITICAL AND NOT DEFERRED EITHER: it is asked for with the layer's other four, and a frame drawn before it lands binds one white texel and is the frame that shipped before this map existed.
